```{r}

library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)
t_obs <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)

data_HGP <- sim_HGP(t_obs = t_obs, a = 2, b = 5)
data_NHGP <- sim_NHGP(t_obs = t_obs, a = 2, b = 5, alpha = 1.5)
data_IGP <- sim_IGP(t_obs = t_obs, mu = 2, lambda = 1)

data_all <- rbind(
  data.frame(t = data_HGP$t,  X = data_HGP$X,  processus = "Gamma homogène (H0)"),
  data.frame(t = data_NHGP$t, X = data_NHGP$X, processus = "Gamma non-homogène (H1)"),
  data.frame(t = data_IGP$t,  X = data_IGP$X,  processus = "Gaussien Inverse (H1)")
)

ggplot(data_all, aes(x = t, y = X, color = processus)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Gamma homogène (H0)"      = "blue",
    "Gamma non-homogène (H1)"  = "red",
    "Gaussien Inverse (H1)"    = "darkgreen"
  )) +
  labs(title = "Trajectoires sous H0 (Gamma homogène) et sous deux alternatives H1",
       x = "Temps", y = "Dégradation", color = "Processus") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Points Observés  Vs Points Simulés

```{r}
# Données
set.seed(42)
N <- 10
t_obs <- c(0, 1.2, 2, 3.8, 5.59, 7.1, 8, 10, 11.4, 12.93, 13, 15.3,17, 18.7, 21, 22.5)
a_true <- 3.2
b_true <- 0.8
sim_mat <- simulate_gamma_rwa(times = t_obs, a = a_true, nsim = 1, b = b_true)
x_obs <- sim_mat[, 1]

bridge <- gamma_bridge(X = x_obs, t = t_obs, a = a_true)


df_obs <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_obs, type = "Points observés")
t_reg <- seq(0, max(t_obs), by = bridge$teq)
df_sim <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = bridge$new_obs, type = "Points simulés")


ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_obs, aes(t, x, color = type), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = df_sim, aes(t, x, color = type), shape = 16, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Points observés" = "red", "Points simulés" = "blue")) +
  labs(title = "Méthode de Grall-Maes : Points observés vs Points simulés",
       x = "Temps", y = "X(t)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank())
```


# Étude du niveau et de la puissance des tests selon différents scénarios 

## Cas 1 : Inspections régulières

# Puissance sous une alternative inverse gamma

```{r}
library(future.apply)
library(statmod)
MC_test_IG <- function(N = 50, t_obs, mu = 2, lambda = 1,
                        ncores = parallel::detectCores() - 1) {
  
  plan(multisession, workers = ncores)
  
  une_iter <- function(i, t_obs, mu, lambda) {
    X <- sim_IGP(t_obs = t_obs, mu = mu, lambda = lambda)
    
    res_h <- gof.gp(X, "Henze")
    rej_h <- as.integer(res_h$T.value > res_h$cv)
    
    res_v <- gof.gp(X, "VGE")
    rej_v <- as.integer(res_v$p.value < 0.05)
    
    res_k <- gof.gp(X, "KS")
    rej_k <- as.integer(res_k$T.value > res_k$cv)
    
    res_b <- gof.gp(X, "BET")
    rej_b <- as.integer(res_b$T.value > res_b$cv)
    
    c(Henze = rej_h, VGE = rej_v, KS = rej_k, BET = rej_b)
  }
  
  res <- future_sapply(1:N, une_iter,
                        t_obs = t_obs, mu = mu, lambda = lambda,
                        future.seed = TRUE)
  taux <- rowMeans(res)
  names(taux) <- c("Henze", "VGE", "KS", "BET")
  return(taux)
}
```




```{r}
n_obs <- 50
t_obs <- seq(0, tmax, length.out = n_obs)
taux_H1_IG <- MC_test_IG(N = N, t_obs = t_obs, mu = 2, lambda = 3)
print(taux_H1_IG)
```
```{r}
n_obs <- 100
t_obs <- seq(0, tmax, length.out = n_obs)
taux_H1_IG <- MC_test_IG(N = N, t_obs = t_obs, mu = 2, lambda = 3)
print(taux_H1_IG)
```
